description: Optional readable structural pattern recipes; each expands to existing ALCG roles, not a new operator or new character.

patterns.name: P_STATE
patterns.gloss: Expose subject and property while reusing an IS relation.

patterns.name: P_ACT
patterns.gloss: Make the agent, action and object roles explicit.

patterns.name: P_ACT2
patterns.gloss: Two-role event descriptor without an implied object.

patterns.name: P_MAY_ACT
patterns.gloss: Possible action: never assert actual occurrence.

patterns.name: P_MAY_ACT2
patterns.gloss: Possible intransitive action, not confirmed actuality.

patterns.name: P_IF_ACTION
patterns.gloss: Conditional action retains antecedent versus consequent.

patterns.name: P_COMPARE
patterns.gloss: Comparison keeps both operands and comparison label.

patterns.name: P_ALL
patterns.gloss: Caller chooses the explicit quantified variable and its scope.

patterns.name: P_SOME
patterns.gloss: Existential quantifier with caller-supplied binder name.

patterns.name: P_NOT
patterns.gloss: Negation preserves the exact embedded scope.

patterns.name: P_AND
patterns.gloss: Conjunction does not imply event time order.

patterns.name: P_BEFORE_ACTS
patterns.gloss: Temporal order preserves the same actor and object across actions.

patterns.name: P_KNOW
patterns.gloss: Provisional knowledge attribution, not proof of the knowledge.

patterns.name: P_SAY
patterns.gloss: Quoting a claim does not assert its truth.

patterns.name: P_WANT_ACT
patterns.gloss: Desire about an action does not assert action occurred.
